intent: Draw attention to deletion while retaining the native scope warning and confirmation. App.ts remove() confirms then sets saved(false); the native warning states that settings on this device are deleted and account/documents are kept. The implementation only changes in-memory status; no persistence deletion is present. One focal mark avoids repeating the warning or crowding narrow layouts. enabled toggles the mark only; destination replaces/removes an unannotated explanatory paragraph independently.

targets.description: The unique existing button#delete, type=button, with aria-describedby=native-warning and click handler remove(). The template ref is on this native button and resolved by viewChild; no wrapper or duplicate control is introduced.

options.description: You will be asked to confirm before continuing.
